meta.title: GDesign – Bespoke Web Design & Digital Experiences
meta.description: GDesign creates refined, bespoke websites and digital brand experiences for ambitious businesses.

hero.title: Digital experiences that inspire – built on premium templates
hero.subtitle: We create high-quality, reusable website templates and tailor the design, content, and brand presence to local businesses and their goals.

services.title: Premium website templates, tailored to your business
services.lead: A thoughtful foundation instead of starting from scratch every time: we combine proven structures with your individual branding, content, and business requirements.
services.primary_description: Responsive websites built on premium templates and tailored to your brand, services, and target audience.
services.second_description: Optimized load times and technical search engine optimization for maximum visibility, excellent user experience, and technical quality.
services.third_description: Unique digital brand presence and thoughtful user journeys that inspire your target audience and build trust.
services.fourth_description: Flexible, secure, and low-maintenance web architectures – perfectly tailored to modular landing pages and modern web applications.
services.fifth_description: Reliable support after launch: Regular updates, security monitoring, and continuous ongoing development of your web project.

gallery.title: Excerpt of Our Digital Projects
gallery.lead: Explore a selection of our tailored web solutions and digital brand presences.
gallery.item1_description: Performant online store with accessible checkout experience and fast load times.
gallery.item2_description: Modern redesign for a medium-sized industrial enterprise with clear brand identity.
gallery.item3_description: High-converting landing page with interactive components and Jamstack architecture.
gallery.item4_description: Custom web portal with accessible UI and optimized loading speeds.

process.title: Your new website in three simple steps
process.lead: Clearly structured, collaborative, and without unnecessary complexity.
process.one_description: In an initial consultation, we analyze your goals, target audience, and requirements. We create a custom concept and a clear design framework.
process.two_description: We develop your project using modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. We strictly prioritize accessibility, performance, and responsive perfection on all devices.
process.three_description: After thorough quality assurance and review, we launch your new website live. Afterwards, we remain by your side as a reliable partner.

about.title: Premium templates. Tailored to your brand.
about.description: GDesign creates high-quality, reusable website templates for local small and medium-sized businesses. Instead of adding unnecessary complexity by building every project from scratch, we combine a reliable technical foundation with individual branding, relevant content, and a clear delivery process.
about.feature_one_description: Optimal usability across all smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
about.feature_two_description: Developed with usability, security, and privacy in mind.

leistungen.meta_description: Our services: web design, performance, UX/UI, Jamstack hosting, maintenance and GDPR-compliant solutions for your business.
leistungen.title: Services & Website Packages
leistungen.lead: Transparent web design services — from concept to launch. No builders, no compromise.
leistungen.packages_lead: Three clearly structured packages — no hidden costs. Each package is a starting point, not a rigid constraint.
leistungen.package1_desc: Professional web presence for sole traders, freelancers, and small businesses looking to make an impact online.
leistungen.package2_desc: Multi-page website with full design and development scope for businesses with a clear brand identity.
leistungen.package3_desc: Complex web projects with custom architecture, Jamstack, and long-term technical partnership.

projekte.title: Premium templates for different industries
projekte.lead: Explore reusable website templates tailored to your brand, content, and business requirements.
projekte.studies_lead: These concepts demonstrate how our reusable website templates can be tailored to different industries. They are illustrative designs, not published client projects or verified performance results.

ueber.meta_description: Craftsmanship instead of site builders: our agency philosophy, tech stack, accessibility and GDPR standards.
ueber.title: Craft, not builders
ueber.lead: We combine premium, reusable website templates with individual branding, relevant content, and a clear delivery process.
ueber.philosophy_desc: We create high-quality, reusable website templates for local small and medium-sized businesses. Each template is tailored to the individual company's brand, services, and audience – with clean code, clear user journeys, and an efficient process.
ueber.stack_lead: Proven, low-maintenance, and future-proof — without framework overhead.
ueber.stack_item1_desc: Semantic, accessible markup. No unnecessary framework overhead.
ueber.stack_item3_desc: Utility-first styling with zero runtime in the build.
ueber.dsgvo_desc: All projects are designed GDPR-compliant from day one: no external fonts, no Google Analytics, no hidden cookies.
ueber.dsgvo_item1: Local fonts instead of Google Fonts CDN
ueber.dsgvo_item2: Netlify Forms instead of third-party form services
ueber.cta_lead: Tell us about your vision – we turn it into an exceptional digital presence.

kontakt_page.meta_description: Start your project with GDesign. Structured enquiry form, direct contact and collaboration FAQ.
kontakt_page.title: Request your project
kontakt_page.lead: Describe your project — we will respond within 24 hours.
kontakt_page.project_type_placeholder: e.g. New website, redesign, landing page
kontakt_page.faq1_q: How does a typical project work?
kontakt_page.faq1_a: We start with a free initial consultation to analyze your goals. You then receive a detailed proposal and a clear project timeline.
kontakt_page.faq2_q: How long does a new website take?
kontakt_page.faq2_a: A simple one-pager is ready in 2–3 weeks. For a multi-page website, plan for 4–8 weeks. Complex projects are scheduled individually.
kontakt_page.faq3_q: Do you support projects after launch?
kontakt_page.faq3_a: Yes. We offer monthly maintenance packages — from simple updates to full technical support including GDPR monitoring.
